attempts.input: Window 1440x900. Opened the Studio cold. Listed buttons and checked that nothing sits off the edge of the window.
attempts.observed: The Direction picker loaded; all 18 'Start from ...' buttons are present, including Vector Horizon, Frontier Gazette, Galactic Goth and Marquee Deco. Nothing sits off the edge, no errors, no network requests. Screenshot rt/shots/r01_start_desktop.png.

attempts.input: Window 375x812 (phone). 'Show me six more Directions', then 'Start from Vector Horizon'. Looked at the card and at Step 1.
attempts.observed: The card is readable and its thumbnail is intact. Step 1 is readable and nothing sits off the edge. The only off-screen control is 'Jump past the preview to the cards' (left -734), which looks like a skip link that is hidden on purpose. No errors. Screenshots rt/shots/r02_VectorHorizon_375x812_z1_card.png and rt/shots/r02_VectorHorizon_375x812_z1_step.png.

attempts.input: 375x812, Vector Horizon, side list to Step 16 'Background at the top of the page', Phone preview, chose 'Field of stars'.
attempts.observed: The stars render. The fixed 'Sample website' label covers the end of the body text line ('We show') at the bottom right of the phone preview. Several stars sit inside the headline and body text area, although the Option's 'Watch for' text says the stars fade out 'so that they do not sit under reading text'. The effect is small. Screenshots rt/shots/r03_VectorHorizon_375_Phone_s16_preview.png and rt/shots/r03_VectorHorizon_375_Phone_s16_window.png.

attempts.input: 375x812, Frontier Gazette (light page), Step 16, Phone, chose 'Field of stars'. Then 1440x900, Galactic Goth, Step 16, Desktop, with 'Field of stars' (already its default).
attempts.observed: Frontier Gazette shows dark specks on the light page, which the Option's 'Watch for' text warns about. On Galactic Goth at desktop width, stars still appear down to the buttons at the bottom of the first screen and right beside the headline letters ('before'); there is no visible fade toward the bottom. The claim 'the stars fade out toward the bottom of the first screen, so that they do not sit under reading text' looks only partly true. I judged this by eye, so the confidence is low. Screenshots rt/shots/r03_FrontierGazette_375_Phone_s16_preview.png, rt/shots/r03_GalacticGoth_1440_Desktop_s16_preview.png and rt/shots/r03_GalacticGoth_1440_Desktop_s16_window.png.

attempts.input: Window 640x360 (a small laptop at 200% zoom), Marquee Deco, Steps 9 and 20, Desktop preview. Also 375x812, Marquee Deco, Steps 9 and 22, Phone preview.
attempts.observed: At 640x360 the Studio stays usable; nothing is off the edge and the preview is readable (rt/shots/r03_MarqueeDeco_640_Desktop_s9_window.png). At 375 px, on Step 9 one preview frame is 420 px wide inside a 375 px frame, so content runs past the right edge (see the next attempt). No errors.

attempts.input: 375x812, Marquee Deco, Step 9 'Text size', Phone preview, clicked card 5 'Very large headings' to show it large. Same with Frontier Gazette.
attempts.observed: PREVIEW DAMAGED. The large phone preview's page is 420 px wide (Marquee Deco) and 427 px wide (Frontier Gazette) inside a 375 px frame. The heading 'ASK FOR AN APPOINTMENT' is cut off at the right edge ('APPOINTMEN'), the body text runs off the right edge, and the left margin is gone (text sits flush against the frame edge). The thumbnail of card 5 shows the same overflow even while another card is on show. The Studio does show the note 'These Decisions pull against each other. Headings in capital letters at a very large size fill the screen…', but the preview is cut off rather than just 'filling the screen'. Screenshots rt/shots/r04_MarqueeDeco_s9_opt4_frame0.png and rt/shots/r04_FrontierGazette_s9_opt4_frame0.png.

attempts.input: 375x812, Vector Horizon and Galactic Goth, Step 9: tried to pick 'Very large headings' with a forced radio check (script), then with a real tap on card 5, key 5, and ArrowRight.
attempts.observed: The forced check failed because the conflict note appears and moves the layout; that was a problem in my script, not in the Studio. A real tap works: card 5 is shown, the main button changes to 'Pick “Very large headings” and continue', and the conflict note appears. Key 5 keeps it. ArrowRight wraps around to card 1 'Your design now'. Keyboard use works. Screenshots rt/shots/r06_VectorHorizon_375_aftercard5.png and rt/shots/r06_VectorHorizon_375_afterkey5.png.

attempts.input: 375x812, each of the four new Directions, Step 9, 'Adjust with sliders', focused each slider and pressed End (Text size 22 px, Heading size jump 1.617).
attempts.observed: PREVIEW DAMAGED. The phone preview page grows to 562 to 797 px wide inside a 375 px frame. The service cards, headings and links run off the right edge. On Frontier Gazette the headline itself overflows and breaks one word per line ('DENTAL / CARE / THAT / EXPLAINS / ITSELF / BEFORE / IT'). The conflict note does appear for the caps looks (visible in the window screenshot). The sliders let a person reach a broken phone page with no message about overflow. Screenshots rt/shots/r07_FrontierGazette_s9_375_max_headline.png, rt/shots/r07_FrontierGazette_s9_375_max_window.png, rt/shots/r07_VectorHorizon_s9_375_max_preview.png and rt/shots/r07_MarqueeDeco_s9_375_max_preview.png.

attempts.input: 375x812, Vector Horizon (also Marquee Deco and Frontier Gazette), Step 9, sliders to the minimum with Home (Text size 13 px, Heading size jump 1.067).
